issue: Role launcher port precheck failed immediately after previous ranks exited, but local launcher failed to propagate remote nonzero result. No new role started, no benchmark request sent.
resolution: Bounded retry of port bind checks up to 180 seconds; remote timeout 220 seconds; propagate remote failures to local status; both role launches succeeded on retry. Acceptance waits for supervisor status creation. Matrix controller continued from B without rerunning A.
limitations: The original failing port number was not recorded, so TIME_WAIT is a plausible explanation, not a conclusively identified socket state. No listening task was stopped.
